Nina (Security): FYI we found a high-severity dependency (crypto-lite v2.1) used in a few services. CVE pending. Immediate action: rotate service keys and upgrade or replace the dependency.

Ravi (Infra): Which services? can we get a list and suggested priority?

deploy-bot: Quick scan: services/auth, services/storage, infra/shared-libs (total 12 manifests). Report: https://internal.tools/reports/deps/1965000000

Nina (Security): Priority: services/auth and infra/shared-libs first. Steps: 1) bump dependency to >=2.3 or remove; 2) rotate affected service account keys; 3) redeploy with canary. Deadline: 2026-03-25 18:00 UTC.

Sam (Backend): Will open PR for services/auth now. tagging @Ravi for infra libs.

Ravi (Infra): I'll schedule rolling redeploys and a key rotation window. Please link PRs here.

Nina (Security): Thanks — file exceptions to security@redwood.ai if you can't meet the deadline. We'll run another scan after the window.
